title: validation: a state_machine rule's authored message cannot name the refused move, and the built-in sentence names it by option value, not label
body:
domain:server#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cyVSbyvGiXWKxk8GG8

Filing gate: ① user-visible UX defect, `reach:` named producer HotCRM (`quote_status_progression`, hotcrm#2371 / hotcrm#2376), and ④ per-layer child of #27381 (row 1).

## Question

Should a `state_machine` rule's `message` be able to say which move it refused ("from Presented to Draft"), and should the built-in sentence name the states by their option labels?

## Reading — `origin/main` bc496bf7, 2026-10-30T10:42Z

Probe: `evaluateValidationRules` on a `select` field `status` with options `draft`/`presented`/`accepted` labelled `Draft`/`Presented`/`Accepted`, update `presented → draft` (a vitest probe in `packages/objectql`, not committed). Output:

```text
authored: message="Cannot move a quote from {{from}} to {{to}}."
  fields=[{"field":"status","code":"invalid_transition","message":"Cannot move a quote from {{from}} to {{to}}.","label":"Status","constraint":{"from":"presented","to":"draft"}}]
built-in: message="Invalid transition for Status: presented → draft"
```

- `authoredRuleMessage` (`packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts`) hands the authored message over verbatim; its docblock says "no `{{…}}` interpolation, because an authored message has no parameter contract and never had one".
- `checkStateMachine` builds `constraint: { from, to }` from the raw option values; the built-in template `invalid_transition` (`packages/spec/src/system/validation-message.ts`) fills `{{from}}`/`{{to}}` from them, so the user reads machine values.
- The spec rule's `message` describe (`packages/spec/src/data/validation.zod.ts`) declares no holes.

## Suspected fix sites

- Contract: declare the holes a `state_machine` message may carry (`{{from}}`, `{{to}}`, as option labels) on the validation rule schema in `packages/spec` — `domain:spec`.
- Runtime: `checkStateMachine` / `authoredRuleMessage` render those holes, resolving option labels in the caller's locale (the same label resolution `resolveFieldLabel` uses), and the built-in `invalid_transition` sentence gets labels too — `domain:server`.

Lane guess: spec contract first, server render after; triage decides. Related: #25933 (closed; the console names the allowed next states).

## Business reason

A user refused a status change reads "Invalid quote progression" with no hint of which move was wrong; HotCRM worked around it by listing the whole path in every message. Without a fix every package writes the same long workaround sentence.

Dedupe: semantic search "state_machine validation message from to placeholders option labels" in objectstack issues, 2 hits (#27381 parent, #25332 closed, unrelated setup-form option text).
